title: Brothers United in Scheme
next_chapter_hook: The legend of the twin fated ones exploded like thunder beside Chen Ji's ears—to unite or to kill each other; the answer to this choice might determine the ultimate fate of him and Chen Nian in this life.

text.content: The Kunlun phantom within the token was still slowly rotating, with purple lightning seemingly coiling around the mountain peak, and some ancient will seemed to be gazing through the layers of mist toward this side. Chen Ji held the token in his palm, his fingertips gently stroking that pattern, the touch cold and real, definitely not an illusion.

dialogue.content: The aura of this summoning token... is entirely different from Holy Sect's communication artifacts. Ye Qing stepped half a step out from the shadows, her slender fingers drawing a virtual arc in the air, and a dark purple spiritual pattern extended from her fingertips, rippling slightly when it touched the token's surface. Her brow creased: "If I am not mistaken, this should be the aura of the ancient Kunlun remnant lineage."

text.content: Ye Qing's analysis plunged Chen Ji into deep thought. The ancient Kunlun remnant lineage—that was an existence older than any sect today. Why would their remnants suddenly appear at the Tianqing Sect? Moreover, the Kunlun remnant lineage had vanished from the world ten thousand years ago; their sudden appearance was by no means coincidental.

dialogue.content: At this moment, Chen Ji felt an intense palpitation in his heart. It was a warning from the depths of his bloodline, warm and urgent, as if an invisible hand was desperately shaking his heart. Brother Ji... Chen Nian's voice rang in his mind, blurred and distant, like across thousands of mountains: It's a trap! There's something terrifying waiting for you over there!

text.content: Chen Nian's warning was like cold water poured down, instantly clearing Chen Ji's mind. But at the same time, he also caught something unusual in this warning—Chen Nian could sense the danger at Kunlun so clearly, which itself indicated some inexplicable connection between her and that place. Twin fated ones, blood connected, sharing weal and woe.

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path's recent movements are indeed诡异的诡异. Ye Qing withdrew her fingers, her expression grave: "The Holy Sect publicly claims the Demonic Path commander position has been vacant for a long time, but after my deep investigation, I discovered that is merely a cover. The true Demonic Path commander has never shown his face, yet has always been manipulating everything behind the scenes. And the aura of this summoning token... is alarmingly similar to that manipulating will in my memory."

text.content: Ye Qing's words made Chen Ji's gaze sharpen abruptly. The mysterious identity of the Demonic Path commander was intelligence he already knew. But he had never imagined that this mysterious Demonic Path commander would have any connection to the Kunlun remnant lineage. Kunlun, Demonic Path, Tianqing Sect... what kind of connection lies hidden between these three?

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's figure flashed in from outside the door, her steps more urgent than usual, clearly having important business. Her gaze fell on the token in Chen Ji's palm, her pupils slightly contracting: "When I was searching through ancient texts in the scripture archive just now, I discovered a record about the twin fated ones. And this record... is related to the summoning token in your hand."

text.content: Su Qingyao took out a yellowed ancient scroll from her sleeve, carefully unfolding it on the table. The characters on the paper were already blurred, but faintly discernible: "Twin fated ones, one body with two souls, meeting each other will change the world. Unite, and heavenly fate becomes one; separate, and heaven and earth are reversed." Her voice was extremely low, yet every word was clear: "Among the annotations to this passage, Kunlun is mentioned."

choice.prompt: Faced with this complex situation, Chen Ji needed to make a judgment within limited time. What should he choose?

choices.description: Invoke the power of the Tianji Record Fragment, attempt to foresee everything that might happen after going to Kunlun, trading intelligence for safety
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption is irreversible, and foresight may be incomplete

text.content: A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment warming slightly in the depths of his consciousness. He did not immediately use the ability, but first rapidly contemplated various possibilities in his heart. If going to Kunlun, possible dangers include: Demonic Path commander's ambush, Kunlun remnant lineage's test, and... unknown variables related to Chen Nian. If not going, he might miss the opportunity to understand the truth.

dialogue.content: Brother Ji, don't go! Chen Nian's voice rang in his mind again, this time clearer and more urgent: That thing over there... it knows us! It has been waiting for both of us!

choices.description: Trust Chen Nian's warning, this matter is extremely dangerous, immediately flee to avoid disaster
choices.visible_cost: Abandon the opportunity to investigate the truth
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the connection between oneself and Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: May miss important opportunities, and danger will not necessarily disappear through avoidance

text.content: Chen Ji put the token into his sleeve, the hesitation in his eyes gradually replaced by something deeper—determination. He slightly shook his head at Ye Qing and Su Qingyao: "This matter cannot be rushed." Chen Nian's warning, the bloodline's agitation, and that vague sense of familiarity... all of this told him that what awaited him at the Kunlun summit was by no means a friendly invitation.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's brow twitched, clearly having reservations about Chen Ji's decision: "Are you sure you want to give up this opportunity? That record about the twin fated ones might be the key to unraveling the mystery of your origins."

choices.description: Since they want him to go, he will go take a look at what tricks are being played
choices.risk_hint: May be a deadly trap set by the other party

text.content: A subtle, meaningful arc curved the corners of Chen Ji's lips. Since the other party did not hesitate to use an ancient Kunlun remnant lineage summoning token to summon him, it showed they valued him far beyond imagination. And being valued in this way was itself proof of his worth. He had never been one to wait passively for death. If they wanted him to go, he would go see exactly what secrets lay within.

dialogue.content: A hint of appreciation flickered in Ye Qing's beautiful eyes: "Interesting. Since that's the case, I'll accompany you. My Demonic Path mist can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record on you, keeping the other party from gauging your true strength." Her lips also curved slightly: "It's been a long time since I've had something this thrilling."

text.content: Three distinctly different approaches intertwined in Chen Ji's mind. Analysis, intuition, reverse strategy—each choice represented different risks and opportunities. And he knew deeply that whichever path he chose would determine the direction of his and Chen Nian's fates.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao closed the ancient scroll, her expression grave as she looked at Chen Ji: "No matter what decision you make, there is one thing you must know in advance." Her voice was extremely low, as if the following words carried the weight of ten thousand jun: "There is another annotation in the ancient text—once the twin fated ones meet, they either unite or kill each other."

text.content: Su Qingyao's words were like a heavy hammer, ruthlessly striking Chen Ji's heart. Unite or kill each other—these six words echoed in his mind, stirring层层涟漪. He下意识地抬手按住心口，那里正在传来陈念同样急促的心跳声。一体双魂，祸福与共——他们之间的羁绊，比他想象的还要深.

dialogue.content: Brother Ji... Chen Nian's voice rang in his mind, this time carrying a strange calmness: "I also don't know what will happen after we meet. But one thing I'm certain of—no matter what happens, I will never hurt you." A barely perceptible tremor threaded through her voice: "All these years, I've been thinking of you."

text.content: A softness flickered in the depths of Chen Ji's eyes. This was the first time since Chen Nian's disappearance all those years ago that she had so clearly conveyed her feelings. He drew a deep breath, pressing that warmth into his heart, then looked up at Ye Qing and Su Qingyao: "I need some time to think. But no matter what, I won't leave Nian'er to face everything alone."

Ye Qing and Su Qingyao exchanged a glance, both seeing the same message in each other's eyes—Chen Ji's words were not idle talk. He truly intended to bear everything for Chen Nian. This sense of responsibility caused an indescribable emotion to flicker in Ye Qing's eyes, and Su Qingyao's expression also softened somewhat.

dialogue.content: Speaking of which, the identity of the Demonic Path commander is indeed诡异的诡异. Ye Qing broke the silence, bringing the topic back on track: "In all these years I've been deep within the Holy Sect, I've never seen that commander in person. But every major strategic adjustment must have his approval." A cold light flickered in her eyes: "And the most recent one was about an investigation plan for a certain forbidden grounds near the Tianqing Sect."

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze abruptly sharpened. The forbidden grounds near the Tianqing Sect—wasn't that exactly the direction the Kunlun phantom indicated? Ye Qing's words seemed to hint that the Demonic Path commander's coveting of the Kunlun remnant lineage had long existed. And would this suddenly appearing summoning token be precisely a key piece in the other party's scheme?

Ye Qing continued: "If my guess is correct, the reason the Kunlun remnant lineage's summoning token ended up in your hands is likely the result of manipulation by the Demonic Path commander behind the scenes. He wants you to go to Kunlun, perhaps wanting to use Kunlun's power against you, or perhaps..." Her voice slightly paused: "He wants to capture both you brothers in one net."

dialogue.content: Capture both in one net? A cold gleam flickered in Su Qingyao's eyes: "If that were truly the case, the other party would be underestimating our Tianqing Sect too much." She turned to Chen Ji, her tone carrying an unmistakable firmness: "Whatever schemes the other party has, you are not suited to risk danger alone. Let me accompany you—my sword technique can at least buy you time to retreat."

text.content: Su Qingyao's words made Chen Ji slightly stunned. When did this aloof Inner Disciple Senior Fellow start involving herself so actively in his affairs? Was it because of curiosity about the Tianji Record, or some deeper reason? He looked up to meet Su Qingyao's gaze, and in those cold, clear eyes, he saw a barely perceptible trace of concern.

dialogue.content: Three top experts traveling together does make quite the party. Ye Qing chuckled lightly, yet her words carried several points of seriousness: "But compared to numbers, what I care more about is our level of understanding of the location. The secrets of the Kunlun remnant lineage may not only interest Chen Ji alone." A meaningful light flickered in her eyes: "The three major sects, the Demonic Path Holy Sect, even the Eye of Heavenly Way... this game of chess is far more complex than imagined."

text.content: When Ye Qing mentioned the Eye of Heavenly Way, an unnoticeable coldness flickered in the depths of Chen Ji's eyes. That existence surpassing all, ever since he learned of its existence, had hung like a sword over his head. Tianji Record, Heavenly Fate, Prophet—exactly what role did all of this play in the Eye of Heavenly Way's chess game? He had never found an answer.

dialogue.content: Brother Ji, no matter what decision you make, I will wait for you. Chen Nian's voice sounded in his mind for the last time, gentle yet firm: "We are one body with two souls; no matter how far apart, I can sense your existence. So... don't rush, take your time." Her voice gradually faded, yet left behind a warmth in Chen Ji's heart.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, the token clasped in his palm. The summoning from Kunlun's summit, Chen Nian's warning, Ye Qing's analysis, Su Qingyao's concern—all of this intertwined in his mind into a complex picture. The gears of fate had already begun to turn, and he stood precisely at the center of these gears.

After a long while, Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze clear as crystal. He tucked the token into his sleeve, raising his eyes to gaze at the night sky beyond the window. The stars were dim, only the Big Dipper flickered hazily between the clouds, pointing toward the north—that was precisely where Kunlun lay. The legend of the twin fated ones, the Demonic Path commander's schemes, the Eye of Heavenly Way's chess game—all clues pointed in the same direction. And he, there, would unravel the ultimate answer of fate.
